links.outcome: Reading grade level and reading ease of ChatGPT lymphoma responses versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Responses were at college or university level; Hodgkin lymphoma mean grade 16.2 (SD 3.4) vs clinical trials 13.6 (SD 2.5; P=.005); Flesch Reading Ease very difficult, graduate level.
links.quote: The Flesch-Kincaid reading levels of the ChatGPT responses by citation source and topic type were determined to be at the college or university level, well above the recommended sixth-grade level.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's readability and citation sourcing for lymphoma-related questions without testing specific deployment interventions or guardrails.
